description.zh: 阿里云合作伙伴（认证ISV）账号ID或者个人用户ID。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) account or individual user.

description.zh:
弹性网卡权限动作。当前仅支持InstanceAttach。

InstanceAttach：允许授权的用户将您的弹性网卡挂载到对方的ECS实例上。ECS实例必须和弹性网卡在同一个可用区中。
description.en:
The ENI permission. Only InstanceAttach is currently supported.

InstanceAttach: allows the authorized user to attach your ENI to their ECS instance. The ECS instance must be in the same zone as the ENI.

description.zh: 弹性网卡权限的地域。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region of the ENI permission. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list of Alibaba Cloud.

title.zh: 为认证ISV或个人授权弹性网卡权限
title.en: Grant ENI permissions to a certified ISV or individual user

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs create-network-interface-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --account-id 1234567890 --network-interface-id eni-bp14v2sdd3v8htln0000 --permission InstanceAttach --region cn-hangzhou
